summary: Completed targeted backend + frontend regression for org config null frameworks bug. Verified normalization and organization creation defaults, confirmed live GET /api/sustainability-config/org-config for Testing org returns 200 with organization_settings.esg_frameworks_enabled=[], and validated Super Admin Org Config UI opens Testing org editor without 'Failed to load config'. No save/edit actions were performed.
critical_code_review_comments: normalize_organization_settings now safely handles null/absent esg_frameworks_enabled via fallback to [].
OrganizationCreate contract validator converts explicit null esg_frameworks_enabled to [], preventing new null writes from API create payloads.
No API flow was MOCKED in this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Used preview URL from frontend/.env and super admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Validated only read/open flows as requested and explicitly avoided any save/update actions.
rca of the issue: Previously, normalize_organization_settings iterated over esg_frameworks_enabled when legacy org data stored null, causing a TypeError and resulting in API 500/Failed to load config. Regression verification confirms fallback handling and create-contract null coercion now prevent this failure path.
